MIND. [1] [Ail.]
Great anxiety and restlessness.
Low-spirited. θ Bronchial catarrh.
Continual sighing, with depression of spirits.
Great anxiety.
Extremely irritable.
Semi-conscious, evidently cannot comprehend what is said to him. θ Scarlatina.
Stupor, delirium and insensibility. θ After suppressed scarlatinal eruption.
Muttering delirium with sleeplessness and restlessness. θ Typhoid scarlatina.
   

SENSORIUM. [2] [Ail.]
Dizzy and throat dry.
Dizzy, face hot, cannot sit up ; drowsy, yet very restless and anxious ; later insensible, with muttering delirium ; recognizes no one. θ Scarlatina.
Dizziness when rising up. θ Typhoid scarlatina.
   

INNER HEAD. [3] [Ail.]
Dull heavy pressing in forehead ; disinclined to think or act.
Darting through temples and back part of head, with confusion of ideas ; beating in occiput.
Head burning hot, with piercing pains.
Severe headache, interrupted by delirium of a frightful kind, with fever and anxiety. θ Typhoid scarlatina.
   

SIGHT AND EYES. [5] [Ail.]
Shunning light.
Pupils widely dilated. θ Scarlatina.
Eyes suffused and congested ; startled look when aroused ; pupils dilated and sluggish. θ Scarlatina.
   

HEARING AND EARS. [6] [Ail.]
Parotid gland sensitive and enlarged. θ Scarlatina.
   

SMELL AND NOSE. [7] [Ail.]
Copious thin, ichorous discharge without fetor. θ Coryza.
Fluent catarrh, with sneezing.
Copious, thin, ichorous and bloody discharge from nose.
Nostrils congested. θ Scarlatina.
   

UPPER FACE. [8] [Ail.]
Face red and hot, covered with a rash. θ Scarlatina.
Face dark as mahogany. θ Suppressed scarlatina.
Chronic speckled, spotted face ; a sort of acne.
Great prostration and a countenance indicating much distress. θ Typhoid scarlatina.
   

TEETH AND GUMS. [10] [Ail.]
Teeth covered with sordes. θ Scarlatina.
   

TASTE, SPEECH, TONGUE. [11] [Ail.]
Taste insipid, flat, feverish. θ Bronchial catarrh.
Tongue dry, parched, cracked.
Tongue moist and covered with white fur ; tip and edges livid. θ Scarlatina.
   

PALATE AND THROAT. [13] [Ail.]
Thick, œdematous and dry choky feeling in throat.
Throat dry, rough and scrapy ; worse in morning.
Irritability of throat and hawking up of mucus.
Hawks up greenish puruloid matter.
Throat tender and sore on swallowing, or on admission of air.
Throat livid, swollen ; tonsils prominent and studded with deep ulcers, oozing a fetid, scanty discharge ; external neck swollen, sensitive. θ Scarlatina.
Diphtheria, with extreme prostration.
Refused to swallow anything for 12 hours. θ Scarlatina.
Throat much swollen, dark red, almost purple in color. θ Scarlatina.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Ail.]
Bowels for days too freely moved ; thin, watery, offensive, passing involuntarily with the urine. θ Scarlatina.
Tapeworm.
   

URINARY ORGANS. [21] [Ail.]
Suppression of urine, impending uræmia, stupor or delirium, with dusky red face. θ Scarlatina.
   

VOICE AND LARYNX. TRACHEA AND BRONCHIA. [25] [Ail.]
Voice hoarse, failing ; almost lost on awaking in morning.
Croupy choking.
   

RESPIRATION. [26] [Ail.]
Breathing hurried, irregular, heavy. θ Scarlatina.
Wheezing, fluent coryza and sneezing ; asthmatic oppression in bronchi ; dyspnœa. θ Bronchial catarrh.
   

COUGH. [27] [Ail.]
Cough : deep, exhausting, with asthmatic expansion of lungs ; deep and painful ; dry, hacking ; in violent fits before retiring and on rising until sputum is raised ; dry, Cough with headache and congestion of face. θ Bronchial catarrh.
Sputa : blood-mixed ; twice raised a mouthful of blood ; bitter, yellow, more mornings ; muco-purulent sputum, free in morning, sticky and scanty during day.
   

INNER CHEST AND LUNGS. [28] [Ail.]
Stitching and aching in chest, under the clavicle, sometimes extending to sternum.
Pressure on chest and sense of fulness.
Lungs feel excessively sore and tender.
Burning in right lung and under left shoulder.
Pain and contracted feeling especially through centre of l. lung, sternal edge.
   

HEART, PULSE AND CIRCULATION. [29] [Ail.]
Dull pain and contracted feeling in region of base of heart and through centre of l. lung.
Pulse : so rapid and small as scarcely to be counted, surface cold and dry ; weak, frequent, irregular. θ Scarlatina.
Rapid small pulse. θ Typhoid scarlatina.
   

OUTER CHEST. [30] [Ail.]
Pressure of clothes on chest is uncomfortable. θ Bronchial catarrh.
   

NECK AND BACK. [31] [Ail.]
Neck tender and very much swollen. θ Scarlatina.
   

NERVES. [36] [Ail.]
Jerking cramps of limbs during sleep. θ Bronchial catarrh.
Great debility, tottering gait, cannot stand long.
In low, adynamic forms of disease, characterized by sudden and extreme prostration, torpor, vomiting, pulse small and rapid, purplish appearance of skin.
   

SLEEP. [37] [Ail.]
During sleep : talks, moans, has sweat, is restless.
Sleeps best on right side. θ Bronchial affections.
Restless and incoherent, most at night ; kept in bed with difficulty. θ Scarlatina.
   

FEVER. [40] [Ail.]
Cold sweat. θ Cholera.
   

ATTACKS, PERIODICITY. [41] [Ail.]
Attacks characterized by fulness of head, with heat ; pains burning, darting in temples and occiput ; vertigo and nausea.
   

SKIN. [46] [Ail.]
Skin dry, but not hot. θ Scarlatina.
Eruption of miliary rash in patches of a dark, almost livid color.
Irregular patchy, livid eruption, disappearing on pressure and returning very slowly ; interspersed with small vesicles ; < on forehead, neck and chest. θ Scarlatina.
Eruption appeared scantily for two days, with sore throat and mild fever. θ Scarlatina.
Petechiæ. θ Scarlatina.
Malignant scarlet fever.
Purple rash, with stupor. θ Scarlet fever.
A livid miliary eruption. θ Scarlatina.
Eruption plentiful, of a bluish tint. θ Typhoid scarlatina.
Eruption is slow to make its appearance, remains livid, and even forehead and face take on a rather purplish color. θ Typhoid scarlatina.
Body and limbs covered with an irregular patchy eruption of a very livid color, disappearing on pressure and returning very slowly. θ Scarlatina.
